messages:
infra-alert-bot: Alert: P1 — repeated cudaErrorMemoryAllocation on node gpunode-13 (us-west-2). 8 OOMs in 5m. Headroom metric shows ~1.2GB. Auto-created thread.

jordan: Paging in. Seeing customer errors for some large-gen requests. Root logs show allocation failures despite headroom. Anyone on runtime/allocator?

mira: I'm here. Looking at allocator snapshots. free_headroom ~= 1.15GB but largest_contiguous_block is ~160MB. Suspicious fragmentation.

lee: That mismatch explains large allocs failing. Post recent KV cache churn we have many small reserved slabs. Can we trigger a quick compaction on that node?

ops-bot: Runbook step run: compaction. Command: POST /nodes/gpunode-13/actions/compact-kv

sam: Before we do that, can we live-route traffic off the node for high-memory requests? I'll prepare a routing rule to avoid nodes with largest_contiguous_block < 256MB.

ana: Notifying CS now — two dedicated customers on gpunode-13 may see retries. Sending a brief note.

mira: Running compaction now. ETA ~20s. Will report back with new allocator snapshot.

infra-alert-bot: Compaction job started: job_id=frag-4321

lee: Also collecting nvidia-smi and dmesg in case kernel OOMs crop up.

mira: Compaction finished. New snapshot: free_headroom=1.05GB, largest_contiguous_block=920MB. OOMs dropped to 0 in last 60s.

jordan: Nice. That looks like fragmentation + pinned small allocations causing the false headroom signal.

sam: Deployed routing rule to avoid nodes where largest_contiguous_block < 256MB. Rule active for 10m window; can extend.

ana: CS update: customers routed away where possible; compaction performed; monitoring for residual errors. Ticket INC-2026-318 created.

lee: Follow-ups: (a) expose largest_contiguous_block metric in Console; (b) add alert when largest_contiguous_block < expected_request_alloc AND free_headroom > threshold; (c) consider allocator change to prefer coalescing or background defrag.

mira: Running cluster-wide fragmentation scan now. Jobs queued to check all us-west-2 nodes.

infra-alert-bot: frag-scan job queued: frag-scan-197. Expect ~3m.

sam: Found 5 nodes with similar fragmentation signature out of 120 in us-west-2. All have high KV pin counts after the recent pinning policy tweak.

lee: Rollback plan: revert small-entry pinning change from 36h ago. That should reduce future fragmentation; scheduling rollback for canary then full.

mira: Creating alert: "largest_contiguous_block < X while free_headroom > Y" and a short-term auto-compaction hook. Will open PR and deploy telemetry within 48h.

jordan: For customer comms timeline: incident window ~09:12–09:18 UTC. Impact: some large contiguous allocations failed leading to elevated errors and retries for a subset of requests. Mitigation: compaction + routing.

ana: Finalized customer messages and added post-incident note to affected accounts. :white_check_mark:

lee: I'll attach allocator code notes to INC-2026-318 and start an RFC for background defragmentation.

mira: I'll draft the postmortem with reproducer steps and mitigation runbook. Assigning owners: metrics (mira), routing (sam), allocator (lee), customer comms (ana).

infra-alert-bot: Incident P1 -> triage done. Handing to owners for follow-ups. Reminder: postmortem due in 72h.

jordan: Thanks all for quick action. Keep channel updated if anything else pops. Closing the live thread.
